scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding golden treasure — but which one?!
Is it the blue egg, the green egg, or the red egg? Pick your answer NOW!
scenes.visual_prompt: blue green red Easter eggs closeup

scenes.narration: The blue egg — ooh, you crack it open and find… a rubber chicken! Nope!
The green egg — inside is… a smelly sock! Ewwww, not the treasure!
That means the RED egg wins! Open it up and — WHOA — golden coins everywhere!
Did you guess red? Amazing! Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
